annual.label: Estimated routine maintenance per year at 12,000 mi (Tesla's schedule at typical shop prices; tires and repairs extra)

maint.job: Front brake inspection, caliper clean and lubricate
maint.every: Yearly or every 12,500 miles in salted-road areas; pads and rotors often last 40,000+ miles
maint.note: Regenerative braking does most of the slowing. Tesla doesn't publish pad and rotor prices, so get a written quote if they need replacing.

maint.job: Rear brake inspection, caliper clean and lubricate
maint.every: Yearly or every 12,500 miles in salted-road areas; pads and rotors often last 40,000+ miles
maint.note: Rarely used brakes can rust and stick in winter climates, which is why Tesla asks for this service.

maint.every: No fixed replacement interval in Tesla's schedule; replace only when the truck warns of a low-voltage battery fault
maint.note: This is the small battery that runs the doors, screens and computers, not the big drive battery. Early failures are covered by the new-vehicle warranty.

maint.every: No replacement needed for the life of the truck under most conditions
maint.note: Tesla warns that damage caused by opening the battery coolant reservoir yourself isn't covered by warranty.
